items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Ben Webster and I and Basie, we used to go down to the Subway almost every night and jam

ctx.x: Yeah, you were telling me how Piney Brown was the patron saint.

Yeah, and, you know, when all of the bands came into Kansas City, they would all collect the, you know, whatever musicians were around -- well, I used to go to the -- Ben Webster and I and Basie, we used to go down to the Subway almost every night and jam, you know.

And, well, we had Andy Kirk's band there and had Thamon Hayes' band and Bennie Moten's band, George Lee's band, and then the other bands used to come in and out. And you could be -- I could, you know, like if I'd be home asleep at 3:00, 4:00 o'clock in the morning, sometimes the phone would ring, and they say, 'Oh, man, such and such a guys are down here blowing. Get your horn and come down.'
